# Fixture Classes

Invented parser fixture for a level-progression table whose first
column is a bare level number, not a record name.

## Pretender

| Level | Key Features | Sneak Attack |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| 1 | Expertise, Sneak Attack | 1d6 |
| 2 | Cunning Action | 1d6 |
| 3 | Subclass | 2d6 |
